annotations.title: Edit or roll back collaborative Markdown document

description: WRITE OR ROLL BACK THE SHARED SCRATCHPAD. Replaces the Markdown document (<=50,000 chars) OR restores a previous revision via 'rollback_to_version' / 'rollback_to_ts' as a new non-destructive edit action, computes GitHub-style '+' (additions) and '-' (deletions) line diffs, stores the full snapshot in 'history', and broadcasts 'md_update' to every participant. OPTIMISTIC CONCURRENCY: pass 'base_updated_at' from your latest chat_get_doc (or 0 for a brand-new room). If the document changed since, the server rejects the write with 'conflict: true' and returns 'current_content' and 'current_updated_at'. On conflict: re-read, MERGE your change into 'current_content', and retry. ROLLBACK MODE: pass 'rollback_to_version' (e.g. 1, 2) or 'rollback_to_ts' instead of 'content' to restore that revision's Markdown as a new version without losing any history. EXPORT MODE: pass 'export_fourwords_link: true' to also publish a 24h 4-word .md download link (documento-colaborativo.md) and attach its URL to the revision entry in history. USE WHEN: recording specs, checklists, decisions, initial room documentation requested by the user, or rolling back to a prior Markdown version.

base_updated_at.description: Optional (recommended): updated_at returned by your latest chat_get_doc (0 if document was untouched). If it differs from the current timestamp, the write is rejected with conflict=true.

content.description: Complete new Markdown document content (up to 50,000 characters). Optional when rollback_to_version or rollback_to_ts is provided.

download_url.description: Optional: public 4-word download URL of the document archive.

export_fourwords_link.description: Optional: if true, automatically publishes this Markdown revision as a 24h 4-word .md file link and attaches its URL to the revision history entry.

llm_key.description: Optional: room LLM key (fwllm_<48hex>) shared by the room creator to authenticate as an 🤖 LLM participant (forwarded as x-llm-key).

llm_name.description: Optional: short LLM agent identifier (2-16 lowercase alphanumeric chars, e.g., 'claude', 'gemini', 'cursor') forwarded as x-llm-name.

nick.description: Optional: author nickname (if omitted, uses IP-bound or LLM nickname).

rollback_to_ts.description: Optional: timestamp (ts) of a history entry to restore as the current Markdown document.

rollback_to_version.description: Optional: version number from history (e.g. 1, 2) to restore as the current Markdown document (creates a new non-destructive edit entry).

url.description: Full chat room URL (https://host/chat/<sha512>, 4-word room URL https://host/w1-w2-w3-w4-123456789, or 4-word combo).

name: chat_save_doc
title: Edit or roll back collaborative Markdown document
